title: Hunt for the Giant Horse
wikitext:
{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW Hunt for the Giant Horse.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Straia]] |location= Mounted Archery Camp |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW|Silver Rupee}} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|Hunt for the Giant Horse||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Hunt for the Giant Horse}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Mounted Archery Camp}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== At the [[Mounted Archery Camp]], [[Link]] can speak to [[Straia]], who is conducting an ecological study of the animals in the area.{{Cite|We're doing an ecological study on the wild animals in the area.|Straia|BotW}} He chose this location because he heard rumors of the [[Giant Horse]] that lives in and is exclusive to the region.{{Cite|We'd heard that there was a {{Color BotW|Red|giant horse}} living in this region. Apparently it can't be found anywhere else... That was all we needed to hear! We headed this way to investigate right away!|Straia|BotW}} When Link asks about the Giant Horse, Straia explains it is potentially a member of a rare, local species of [[Horse]].{{Cite|The really big horse in this region is likely part of a rare, local species.|Straia|BotW}} Due to [[Enemies in Breath of the Wild|monsters]] in the area, though, Straia has been unable to reach the Giant Horse.{{Cite|However, with all the monsters roaming around, we simply can't go any farther. To be so close to discovery...|Straia|BotW}} He even saw a [[Lynel|monster that looked like a Horse]], which he initially mistook for the Giant Horse.{{Cite|That's right... There was even a monster that looked quite a lot like a horse... I approached it, thinking at first that it was the {{Color BotW|Red|giant horse}} we've been looking for, but... Oh, it was terrible...|Straia|BotW}} Based on Link's appearance, Straia presumes that he is a strong adventurer.{{Cite|Just from looking at you, I'd guess that you're an adventurer, right? You certainly look strong.|Straia|BotW}} As such, he asks him to catch the Giant Horse and bring it back for them to see.{{Cite|Hrm... Hey, how would you like to go and catch a {{Color BotW|Red|giant horse}} for us?|Straia|BotW}} When Link accepts his suggestion, Straia directs him to the [[Taobab Grassland]], where the Giant Horse is rumored to live.{{Cite|[Leave it to me.] Ah, you're a lifesaver! They say that the {{Color BotW|Red|giant horse}} lives around the {{Color BotW|Blue|Taobab Grassland}}... That'd be northwest of here.|Straia|BotW}} He tells Link that the request is not urgent, which starts the [[Side Quest]].{{Cite|Do you think you could catch it and bring it back here? Don't stress out over the request, though!|Straia|BotW}} There are two Lynels located on the [[Oseira Plains]], which lead into the Taobab Grassland. Link must either bypass or defeat them in order to reach the Giant Horse. The Giant Horse itself requires at least two [[Stamina Wheel]]s to tame, though it can be ridden past the Lynels without the need for a fight. Link can ride the Giant Horse back to the Mounted Archery Camp and show it to Straia.{{Cite|That horse... It's huge...|Straia|BotW}} He is shocked by its size and determines that it must be of a species native to the region.{{Cite|I've never seen on that big! That is definitely an endemic species!|Straia|BotW}} He asks to take a closer look at it, after which he is pleased.{{Cite|Sorry, but can I take a good look at that horse? Wow. With this much info, I can feel my spirit for discovery murmuring in contentment.|Straia|BotW}} He notes that it is different to see something instead of reading about it and thanks Link for the opportunity.{{Cite|It's definitely different seeing something with your own eyes rather than just reading about it. Thank you!|Straia|BotW}} As a reward, he gives Link a [[Silver Rupee]], completing the Side Quest.{{Cite|This is to thank you for helping with our investigation!|Straia|BotW}} ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Out in the Faron Grasslands, you came upon Straia, who is conducting a study on animals in the region. He said he's specifically looking for the rumored {{Color BotW|Red|giant horse}} that lives on the Taobab Grasslands.

Straia asked you to help with his investigation into the {{Color BotW|Red|giant horse}}. After all, how giant could it really be? |- | Complete | You captured the giant horse in Taobab Grasslands.

Giant was an accurate description, to be sure. This beast could probably trample monsters with ease.

When you brought it back to Straia, he was very surprised. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Giant Horse * Mounted Archery Camp * Straia }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
